[EN] Some of the plague mutants used to be our trained soldiers. If they decided to organize, we might not survive an attack.

Will you hunt down the {@LinkCreature:40#23#guardian aberrations} and the {@LinkCreature:40#19#mutant}, {@LinkCreature:40#19#mad}, and {@LinkCreature:40#24#crazed polykinds}? And bring back anything that will identify them to their families.
[ES] Algunos de los mutantes de la plaga solían ser nuestros soldados entrenados. Si decidieran organizarse, puede que no sobrevivamos a un ataque.

¿Darás caza a los {@LinkCreature:40#23#guardian aberrations} y a los {@LinkCreature:40#19#mutant}, {@LinkCreature:40#19#mad} y {@LinkCreature:40#24#crazed polykinds}? Y trae de vuelta cualquier cosa que permita identificarlos ante sus familias.

[EN] They should not have died like that, but for them it was better than living.

I'll return these tokens to their families.
[ES] No deberían haber muerto así, pero para ellos era mejor que vivir.

Devolveré estas fichas a sus familias.

[EN] We're just hoping the {@LinkCreature:40#19# polykinds} and {@LinkCreature:40#23#aberrations} don't attack before you take them out.
[ES] Solo esperamos que los {@LinkCreature:40#19# polykinds} y {@LinkCreature:40#23#aberrations} no ataquen antes de que acabes con ellos.
